description: "McGuffey's Second Eclectic Reader" by William Holmes McGuffey is an educational reader designed for children, likely written in the mid-19th century. The book serves as a reading and moral instruction tool, using various prose and poetry selections to engage young readers and help them develop literacy skills alongside positive moral values.
